messages.subject: read.xls
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I am a newbie.
I heard that there is a function called read.xls in R, but I tried it
and it didn't work. Can anybody help me? here is what I did:
sOct13=read.xls("/users/laura/s_SA_12oct.xls")
Error: could not find function "read.xls"

I have had better luck with read.csv  -- maybe I should just stick to
that?
Thanks,
 --laura

messages.subject: Re: read.xls
messages.body_plain:
hi laura,

you can find the "read.xls" function in
library(gdata) & library(xlsReadWrite)

quite genrally, whenever you get an error like that ("could not find
function XYZ")
try

?<name of function> (e.g. ?read.xls  ...usually R will tell you (once
again) that it cannot find a documentation for that and will suggest
you try

help.search("NAME")

do that and you will get the results of a fuzzy search for that (set
of) key word(s)

then just load the package that has the function you need w/

library(gdta)

have a look at what it has to offer using

library(help=gdata)

and get details with

?read.xls

HTH,
best,
--daniel

  there is no package called 'xlsReadWrite'
No help files found matching 'read.xls' using regexp matching
> install.packages(xlsReadWrite)
Error in install.packages(xlsReadWrite) : object "xlsReadWrite" not
found
> install.packages(gdata)
Error in install.packages(gdata) : object "gdata" not found

It still looks like there is no way to get data in from xl.
Anybody want to help?
--laura
